items.a: An HR and payroll system for organisations in India: staff records, attendance, face check-in, leave, salary structures, payroll, payslips, bank files and reports in one place.

items.q: How do we move our existing staff in?
items.a: Import your staff list from an Excel sheet. Each row is checked and errors are shown before anything is saved.

items.q: Do staff need to install an app?
items.a: No. The staff portal works in any phone browser and can be added to the home screen. Staff sign in with their mobile number and a one-time code.

items.q: Can new joiners fill in their own details?
items.a: Yes. Staff can register from the sign-in page with mobile verification and upload documents. HR approves them before they get portal access.

items.q: What hardware do we need for face attendance?
items.a: Any phone, tablet or laptop with a camera and a browser. No special device is required.

items.q: Can someone mark attendance for a colleague?
items.a: The kiosk records the face it recognises. Portal face check-in only counts when the face matches the signed-in employee.

items.q: How are late and half-day decided?
items.a: From each employee's shift and your grace time. The same rules apply to face scans, portal punches and HR corrections.
Only if you switch it on for an employee, and only between their check-in and check-out while the portal is open.

items.q: Do we have to use a fixed salary layout?
items.a: No. You build each salary structure from your own columns and formulas.
Runs move through HR review, finance review and final approval before they are locked.
Any bank. You set up your bank's file layout once, and files are exported only from locked or paid runs.

items.q: Can some staff be paid in cash?
items.a: Yes. Cash-paid staff stay on the payroll sheet but are left out of the bank file.

items.q: Can one organisation see another's data?
items.a: No. Each organisation's data is kept separate.

items.q: Who can see what inside our organisation?
items.a: Access follows roles. You can create custom roles and limit department heads to their own department.
Yes. The audit log shows what changed and who changed it.
